decisions.rationale: Leo explicitly said they're still deciding and asked for another week (email:dfd0d87f), signalling paused evaluation. First project reached day 0 but no invite sent and key milestone unreached 6 days in; open ticket (tick_6d5f9f4faacd) is for a feature that doesn't exist, so no pull. Low odds within 8 days unaided.

draft.subject: Re: Anything I can help with?
draft.body:
Hi Leo,

Thanks for being straight with me -- totally fair to take another week to decide, and I won't crowd you in the meantime.

On your open ticket: a weekly summary email isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap. Tariq has that one and will follow up.

One thing that often helps a team evaluate properly: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, so your team lead can look alongside you. Happy to walk through that with you on a short call this week if it's useful -- otherwise just reply when you're ready.

Best,
Chidi
